response.text: {"intro":"Fernwood Labs has 14 people in 5 teams and runs 6 apps on Bike: Hiring, Onboarding, Time off, Spend, Tools and budgets, and Customer contracts. Each one is a set of sheets, the steps a row moves through, and who can see and do what.","paragraphs":["Fernwood Labs keeps its people in one shared list, and every app draws on it to fill in names such as hiring manager, buddy, owner or requester. The 14 people sit in 5 teams: Engineering, Growth, Customer, Operations and People. Aisha Khan and Leo Grant have no manager recorded, so anything that goes to a person's manager has no one to go to for them.","Hiring is run by Wade. Openings move from Draft to Open and then to Filled or Closed. Candidates move from Applied through Screen, Interview and Offer to Hired or Rejected. When a candidate moves to Interview, three interviews are added and each interviewer gets a scorecard task. When a candidate is Hired, the opening moves to Filled and a plan starts in Onboarding with their name, start date and manager.","Onboarding is run by Priya. Each plan names a manager, a buddy and a person for IT, and has tasks with an owner and a due date that move from To do to Doing to Done. Priya, Wade and Aisha see every plan. Managers, buddies and task owners see only their own.","Spending is run by Lena. Purchases move from Submitted to Approved, Ordered and Received, or to Rejected. Expenses start at Needs a receipt, then go to Submitted, Approved and Paid, or to Rejected. The person who asked cannot approve or reject their own request. Lena approves submitted expenses. If an expense has no category, an AI step suggests one and Lena confirms it. Tools and budgets lists each tool with its vendor, seats, yearly cost, renewal date and owner, and holds a budget for each team by quarter. Lena, Wade and Krishna can see it. It has no rows yet.","Revenue is tracked in Customer contracts, run by Wade. Each contract has a yearly value, a start date, a renewal date and an owner. Contracts move from Draft to Signed, Active, Renewal due, and then Renewed or Ended. 60 days before a contract's notice date it moves to Renewal due and its owner gets a reminder. 30 days before the notice date, if it is still in Renewal due, Wade and the owner are told. When a signed PDF is added, an AI step reads it and fills the row for the owner to confirm.","Time off is run by Lena. People ask for vacation, sick or personal days. A request is only accepted if it is within their balance. Requests go to the person's manager, and when one is approved or declined, the person and Lena are told. The person who asked cannot approve it. No public holidays are listed yet.","Much of this runs by itself. Offers above a role's salary band wait on Wade, and offers within the band wait on the hiring manager. Scorecards are requested on the day of an interview, and renewals are flagged ahead of the notice date. Decisions reach people as waiting items and notifications. Every change, made by hand or through Customize, is recorded in the Audit log."],"sentences":[{"capability":"Hiring","sentence":"Holds openings, candidates and interviews; Wade approves offers above the salary band, hiring managers send offers and run their roles, and interviewers score their interviews."},{"capability":"Onboarding","sentence":"Holds a plan for each new hire with a manager, buddy and IT person, plus their tasks; Priya, Wade and Aisha manage all plans and owners move their own tasks."},{"capability":"Time off","sentence":"Holds requests, balances and holidays; everyone asks for their own time off, managers decide, and Lena and Wade see everything."},{"capability":"Spend","sentence":"Holds purchases, their lines and expenses; everyone adds their own, Lena approves expenses, and Krishna sees every purchase."},{"capability":"Tools and budgets","sentence":"Holds the tools the company pays for, who has a seat, and each team's budget by quarter; only Lena, Wade and Krishna can see it."},{"capability":"Customer contracts","sentence":"Holds contracts, renewals and customer contacts; Wade and Krishna manage all contracts and owners handle their own."}],"phrases":[{"connection":"Hiring > Onboarding","phrase":"when someone is hired, their first week is planned"}],"worth":["13 candidates have no offer approval recorded, so it is hard to tell which offers were approved or declined.","18 expenses have no category and no record of how they were paid, which makes spending reports less reliable.","Aisha Khan and Leo Grant have no manager, so their time off requests have no one to go to."]}
